notes: Creator CRM (creator_relationships/creator_notes/creator_tasks/creator_conversation_summaries) reuses outreach_sends/inbound_messages live for history rather than duplicating them.
No cross-platform creator-identity merging built (automatic or otherwise) -- the 'never auto-merge creator identities' constraint is satisfied by omission, not an extra guard.
requestAffiliateCreation is admin-only and the sole code path that can create a creator_affiliates row -- never AI, never automatic.
Interruption safety for affiliate creation (pending -> creating -> terminal) proven by a +mockfail test, same pattern as Wave 3's outreach send.
pollWhopConversions reuses provider_mailbox_state (workspace+provider+cursor) instead of a new table.
No public Whop webhook endpoint built -- polling is the real primary path in V1, not a backstop; same reasoning as Wave 3's deferred reply webhook.
getWorkspaceAnalytics + getCampaignAnalytics compute every number live from stored rows at read time -- no caching, no pre-computation.
Derived rates (e.g. average match score) always returned with their sampleSize; UI flags samples under 5.
Qualification failure reasons reused from the real measuredValues.reasons already persisted by Wave 2's qualifyCampaignCreators, not recomputed.
Whop conversion revenue summed per currency (array), never mixed into one misleading total.
No predictive ML or forecasting anywhere in this module.

realFindingsFixed: Safety gate never checked creators.status/creator_relationships.status='do_not_contact' -- a human could mark a creator do-not-contact in the CRM and the system would still send. Fixed in both executeScheduledSend and performDryRunEvaluation; proven by real end-to-end tests.
/ops had zero authentication and was about to start showing real job payloads (workspace/creator/email data). Gated behind requireSession + Owner/Admin, same bar as /settings/integrations.

approveProductIntelligence and decideApproval (the two highest-stakes admin-only approval actions) had no test proving a Member-Operator is actually rejected. Added tests/domain.rbac.hardening.test.ts.
The Wave-1-flagged Operations TODO (removeOnFail: false 'the Operations surface (Wave 6) reads these') was still open -- built real failed-job visibility + a real, tested retry action.
confirmedSolidNoChangeNeeded: RLS: all 29 tenant-scoped tables have RLS enabled+forced with the identical safe policy shape (live pg_class/pg_policies query, not just migration source).
RBAC: every actor-facing domain function enforces requireRole; every worker-only function is never called directly from an API route (verified by grep across the whole call graph).

AI safety: all 6 registered operations pass the hard-restriction check; no AI-triggered worker path ever calls a protected-state-changing function (updateCampaign/addSuppression/addMember/decideApproval/approveProductIntelligence).
No silent bypass of outreach_sends.status, creator_affiliates.status, or campaigns.status exists outside their one controlled write path each.

Suppression, kill switch, approval validity, content-pinning, idempotency, caps, cross-campaign safeguard, schedule validity, interruption safety, reply dedupe/ambiguous/unknown matching all still pass their existing tests unmodified.
built: packages/lib/src/webhookVerification.ts: real, tested, provider-independent HMAC-SHA256 signature verification + replay-window check. Not wired to a public endpoint yet -- that is provider-specific and deferred to the real provider decision, per the mission's 'stop at the authenticated provider boundary' rule.
apps/web/lib/opsQueueDetail.ts + updated /ops page + POST /api/ops/jobs/:lane/:jobId/retry: real per-lane job-state counts, real failed-job list, stuck-job flag, real retry action, admin-gated.
